✈️ Flight → HKDL Journey Map

Customer touchpoints across the complete booking lifecycle

1
Discover
Pre-Booking
🎯 Dual Awareness Channels (Parallel)
• Flight Results Banner — Carousel ad on eligible flight results pages for GBA destinations (BKK → HKG, etc.)
• Campaign Landing Module — Promotional feature on key campaign landing pages (runs in parallel for additional exposure)
• Eligible destinations: Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Macau
2
Acquire
Booking Confirmed
💳 Auto-Issued Coupon
• Instant Delivery to My Account wallet upon flight booking confirmation
• Tiered discount structure: Spend more, save more on HKDL tickets
• Zero friction — no hunting for promo codes, coupon lands automatically
3
Activate
7 Days Before Trip
📲 Precision-Timed Push
• Optimal Booking Window — 7 days before departure is the sweet spot for last-minute experience planning
• Precise targeting: Users with active coupon will receive the customized push 7 days before their flight departure
4
Convert
At POI Booking
🎫 Flyer Exclusive Tag
• High-Visibility Tagging on eligible HKDL ticket products during POI booking flow
• Badge messaging: "機票旅客專屬優惠" (Flight-Booker Exclusive Perk) with discount amount displayed for users with the special coupon
Seamless customer journey from flight discovery through HKDL ticket conversion
